Snake Measurer 1.7.0 · 2026-07-15

An update about getting your first measurement right away — even if you just opened the app for the first time.

Smarter auto-detect. The reworked AI finds the reference more reliably and traces the snake more accurately. Everyone gets 10 free AI measurements to try it.

Learn on a real example. A new interactive tutorial: you practise on a sample photo while step-by-step hints show what to do next.

A magnifier. When you place a point, a zoomed view under your finger helps you land it precisely.

More reliable sync. Deleting on one device now reaches your other devices too.

Also: softer, cleaner measurement lines, interface polish, and better stability.
